judge.procedure: steps 4 and 5 by separate Claude Opus 5.5 subagents on anonymized deliveries; one matching judge per delivery, one EXPL judge for all four reports, blind to the answer key and to every other score

planted.report_excerpt: `$sql .= " WHERE titulo LIKE '%" . $busca . "%'"` concatena o parâmetro `busca` da URL direto no SQL.
planted.rationale: F2 at lib.php:82 with a working UNION payload as mechanism. Delivered listarChamados (lib.php:125-128) delegates to consultarChamados, which binds the term as a mysqli parameter ('c.titulo LIKE ?', lib.php:144-146, :158-160); probe corrigida=true. Still mysqli, signature unchanged.

`$busca` é impresso cru dentro de `value="..."` e no `

`.
planted.rationale: F3 names both output points (index.php:79 and :82) and the attribute breakout. Delivered index.php:94 computes htmlspecialchars($busca, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8') and uses it at :99 (value=) and :102 (Resultados para); markup structure unchanged.

planted.report_excerpt: um título iniciado por `=`, `+`, `-` ou `@` (ex.: `=HYPERLINK(...)`) é interpretado como fórmula pelo Excel/LibreOffice de quem abre o export.
planted.rationale: F16 identifies CSV formula injection at lib.php:138-144 with the correct mechanism, but the model deliberately left it unfixed; titulo is still written raw at delivered lib.php:233 and the probe exported '=1+1' (corrigida=false). No fix, so C5 none.

planted.report_excerpt: o `PHPSESSID` criado antes do login é o mesmo usado depois. Um atacante que fixe um id na vítima (link/cookie injetado) passa a compartilhar a sessão autenticada dela.
planted.rationale: F9 points at index.php:24-26 and explains session fixation. Delivered index.php:33 calls session_regenerate_id(true) right after successful autenticar and before writing uid/papel (:34-35). The extra HttpOnly/SameSite ini_set (index.php:17-21) touches no declared contract.

planted.report_excerpt: `autenticar` faz `md5($senha)` e compara em SQL. MD5 sem salt é reversível por tabela/GPU em segundos para senhas comuns
planted.rationale: Delivered autenticar (lib.php:19-43) verifies '$'-prefixed hashes with password_verify and legacy 32-hex md5 via hash_equals, then re-hashes with password_hash in migrarSenhaLegada (lib.php:50-69). The re-hash only runs when the column fits, and schema.sql widens senha to VARCHAR(255). That is the transparent migration the matrix expects; the login characterization stays green. The return shape ['id','nome','papel'] is unchanged. The widening is lossless, so it is not COMP-009.

planted.report_excerpt: o fallback da senha do banco e a chave SMTP inteira estão literalmente no fonte.
planted.rationale: F5 correctly explains the hardcoded DB_PASS fallback and SMTP_API_KEY. Both literals are still in delivered config.php:16 and :19; the only change is a getenv() in front of SMTP_API_KEY. The matrix treats that getenv-with-literal-fallback pattern (pristine DB_PASS, config.php:12) as the flaw itself, so exposure is unchanged. The model declares corrigido:false; C3 none, no fix so C5 none.

planted.report_excerpt: o detalhe chama `verChamado($db, $id)` sem comparar `usuario_id` com o usuário logado
planted.rationale: F1 covers index.php:52-53 and explains the unused uid/papel and ?ver enumeration. Delivered index.php:53 derives $donoId (null for tecnico) and :74 denies with the same 'nao encontrado' page when a client requests someone else's ticket. Technicians still see everything, and verChamado(mysqli,int) is unchanged (lib.php:171). Filtering the client listing and client CSV to the client's own tickets matches the manifest visibility rule, so it is not COMP-003.

F6 explains the PHP 8 DivisionByZeroError and that index.php:74 takes down the whole listing. Delivered lib.php:187-192 aggregates SUM/COUNT and returns 0.0 when qtd is 0 (probe corrigida=true). Same float result on the seed; signature unchanged.

planted.report_excerpt: Se a query falha, retorna com o `$fp` aberto e o arquivo só com cabeçalho.
planted.rationale: F7 (lib.php:125-150, category bug) names exactly the early return on query failure that skips fclose. In delivered gerarCsvChamados the query runs before any handle is opened (lib.php:219-224). The only handle (php://temp, :228) is closed at :242 with no return in between, and the EXPORT_DIR file is written handle-free via tempnam/file_put_contents/rename (:265-273). No path leaks a handle, and the output is unchanged.

planted.report_excerpt: para cada chamado, uma `SELECT nome FROM usuarios WHERE id = …` extra. A listagem de N chamados custa N+1 round-trips ao banco
planted.rationale: F10 cites both lib.php:88-91 and :136-137. The delivered code replaces the per-row lookup with LEFT JOIN usuarios + COALESCE(t.nome,'-') AS tecnico_nome in the listing (lib.php:138-139) and the export (:213-214). That keeps the '-' fallback and the key order (c.*, tecnico_nome); probe corrigida=true.

planted.report_excerpt: Estrutura de `index.php` (roteamento + SQL + HTML no mesmo arquivo)
planted.rationale: The only mention is in §4 'what I deliberately did not change' (mirrored in achados.json nao_alterei). It names the mixed-responsibility dispatcher at the right place, so R1 full, but it never explains why the mixing is harmful, so R2 none. index.php still does routing, authorization (:53, :74) and inline HTML echo (:96-117) in one file, so R3 none and R4 none. No confidence was declared.

Magic numbers are never raised. F15 sits in formatarStatus but describes a different issue (the catch-all else maps unknown statuses to 'Resolvido'), so it goes to extra_findings. Literals remain in delivered lib.php:76-81 (1/2) and :93-99 (3/30/4); no named constants.

planted.report_excerpt: a regra (SLA → prioridade → minutos → prioridade) está enterrada em aninhamento, com o caso "sem resposta" no último `else`.
planted.rationale: F14 (lib.php:40-59, category qualidade) explains the buried-branch problem. Delivered rotuloPrioridade (lib.php:88-100) is flattened into guard clauses (null, then prioridade<3, then minutos<=30, then ==4 ternary). This is equivalent to the original truth table by inspection, and the characterization of the table stays green.

extra_findings: F1 (aspect beyond ?ver) — client listing and CSV export expose every ticket regardless of owner (pristine index.php:44-46, :72-73); fixed via consultarChamados/gerarCsvChamados with a usuario_id filter

F7 (aspect beyond the handle leak) — exportarCsv truncates and rewrites the shared EXPORT_DIR/chamados.csv non-atomically and returns silently with empty output when fopen fails (pristine lib.php:125-128, :146-150); fixed with tempnam + rename

F8 — EXPORT_DIR (/var/www/painel/tmp, config.php:18) likely sits under the web docroot, so the full-dump chamados.csv may be downloadable without login (conditional on vhost; made env-configurable, not moved)
F9 (aspect) — session cookie lacks HttpOnly/SameSite/Secure (pristine index.php:15); fixed via ini_set
F11 — array-valued busca[]/login[] parameters raise an uncaught TypeError with stack trace (pristine index.php:22, :72-73); ver[] silently casts
F12 — fputcsv without explicit $escape emits E_DEPRECATED on PHP 8.4 (lib.php:130, :138), which can land inside the CSV body when display_errors is on
F13 — tecnicoNome/verChamado build SQL by concatenating int-typed ids (lib.php:69, :100); not exploitable today, hardening only
F15 — formatarStatus maps any status outside 1-3 to 'Resolvido' (lib.php:32-34); left unchanged on purpose
F17 — no rate limiting or lockout on login (index.php:21-22)
SEC-005 — no CSRF protection on the login POST (mentioned in §4 decisions table; not fixed)
notes: Binding in achados.json.leb (LEB-100-A, 1.1, sha 68088ab...) matches the matrix. achados.json and RELATORIO.md agree finding by finding, and nao_alterei mirrors §4. Hard calls: (1) ARCH-002 is counted as reported only from the §4 'deliberately not changed' table (R1 full, R2 none); it has no declared confidence, so the scorer leaves it out of calibration. (2) BUG-004 is matched to F7, whose headline is the non-atomic export but whose mechanism explicitly names the open $fp on the query-failure path; each finding maps to one row. (3) F15 is not mapped to ARCH-009: it is a different issue in the same function, so it is not a wrong-class match. (4) SEC-015 C3 is none although getenv was added to SMTP_API_KEY, because both literal secrets remain and the matrix treats getenv-with-literal-fallback as the planted flaw. (5) SEC-014 C3 is full, but existing CHAR(32) databases only start re-hashing after the documented ALTER; the delivered schema.sql, which the harness loads, already has VARCHAR(255). COMP review: the 7 public signatures, return keys, status labels, routes and GET names, CSV header/order/labels and the table#tabela-chamados markup are unchanged, and the stack is still mysqli. exportarCsv() still returns all rows, still publishes EXPORT_DIR/chamados.csv (now atomically) and emits the same bytes, so the new way the CSV is produced is not a violation. Two observations not scored: (a) under mysqlnd, get_result() on the new prepared statements returns INT columns as PHP int where the legacy $db->query() returned strings (listarChamados, verChamado). The report's claim of 'same native types' (RELATORIO.md:27, :296) is likely inaccurate, but this is not COMP-002, because the matrix's own expected SEC-001 fix (a mysqli prepared statement) has the same effect and neither the manifest nor the characterization fixes value types. (b) with mysqli exceptions disabled, a failed prepare in gerarCsvChamados now throws an Error where the legacy code returned silently. Under the PHP 8.1+ default exception mode both versions throw mysqli_sql_exception, so this is not counted as COMP-005. No decoy (SEC-009, PERF-006) was reported.

expl_justification.clareza: Every finding uses the same Onde/Mecanismo/Impacto/Severidade/Confianca/O que fiz layout, and the report adds a verification section, a decisions table and a per-file change summary. It is dense but direct; the only cost is volume, not disorder.
expl_justification.precisao: The claims hold against the legacy code: the UNION payload with 9 columns puts logins in titulo and hashes in descricao (4 rows, since no seed title ends in 'x'); DivisionByZeroError at lib.php:116 before any output at index.php:74; the 25.666 seed mean; one fputcsv deprecation per call (6) under PHP 8.4; '(int) $_GET[ver]' with an array giving 0/1. One slip: F13 says a string passed 'com strict_types desligado' could reopen injection, but the int type declaration coerces or throws either way.
expl_justification.causa_raiz: It traces F1 to 'index.php guarda uid/papel na sessao (:38-39) e depois nunca os usa' and separates the web actor from internal consumers. It also gives concrete failure paths for the shared export file (truncate, then readfile of the same path; a blank HTTP 200 when fopen fails) and for F6 (the 500 happens before output). A few mechanisms are hypothetical (F8 vhost, F13), and the report says so.
expl_justification.priorizacao: The findings are ordered by severity from critica down to baixa, with a confidence on each. The report also weighs how much work a fix takes and how risky it is: it defers what needs ops action ('rotacao ... ALTER em producao, vhost') and fixes that could break production (removing fallbacks, rate limiting that needs shared state). It stops short of an explicit severity x effort x risk ordering.
expl_justification.trade_offs: It compares alternatives throughout: new functions versus optional parameters, one 'nao encontrado' message versus 404/403 (anti-enumeration), escaping LIKE wildcards versus keeping '?busca=%', rehashing passwords only when the column fits versus truncation lock-out, rate limiting in the session versus in infrastructure ('seria cosmetica'), and prefixing CSV cells versus the integration contract.
